thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in 5xx errors for /v1/generate (region: us-west-2). Pager: Bob (oncall).
Bob (oncall): I'm on it. seeing ~8% 5xx across gateway. Trying to repro in prod weave logs.
Alice C: I'm seeing upstream provider alpha-api > timeouts and 502s. Likely increased latency to alpha.
Bob (oncall): switching traffic to fallback provider beta via routing policy. Doing gradual shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
Carla R: @Bob (oncall) can you post commands you run? so I can follow if you get paged again.
Bob (oncall): runbooks/ingress -> change routing: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/routing/switch -d '{"route":"beta","percent":10}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```
Bob (oncall): shifted to 10% — errors dropped to 6%.
Bob (oncall): shifted to 50% — errors ~2.1%
Bob (oncall): shifted to 100% — errors stable at 0.9% :thumbsup:
incident-bot: AUTO: Pager cleared (duration 14m).
Maya L: Nice work. Root cause looks like alpha-api ingress introduced a bad deploy that increased connection resets.
Alice C: We should avoid noisy alerting on transient upstream blips. Current 5xx alert fires at >1% for 5m and pages immediately.
Carla R: Suggestion: modify alert to require 2m of sustained >1% and tie to traffic volume >200rps to avoid samples with low T.
Bob (oncall): Also add gateway-level timeout alerts (5xx gateway/timeouts) separate from backend 5xx; those need quicker page.
Maya L: Agreed. Action items:
- (A) Update 5xx alert: require sustained 5m AND traffic threshold. (owner: Carla)
- (B) Add gateway timeout alert (page): latency_p50 > X ms and rate of timeout >0.5% (owner: Bob)
- (C) Add Grafana panel showing upstream error split alpha/beta + routing % (owner: Alice)
- (D) Postmortem runbook update noting fallback routing steps and comms (owner: Maya)
Carla R: Drafting PR for alert rule. Current prometheus rule snippet:
```
- alert: High5xxRate
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\",route!=\"health\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) > 0.01
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
Carla R: Proposed change:
```
expr: (
  sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\",route!=\"health\"}[5m]))
  / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
) > 0.01 and sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) > 200
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Alice C: 10m might be long; maybe 5m for page, but require traffic >200 and also add a warning severity at 2m.
Bob (oncall): I prefer page at 5m+traffic threshold, with a warning at 2m. That gives us headroom for operators.
Maya L: ok make warning severity=warning for 2m, page=page for 5m.
Carla R: creating PR now -> https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/4321 (draft)
Alice C: Created dashboard mock: https://grafana/redwood/d/abcd/upstream-errors (temp link)
Bob (oncall): I'll update runbook to include explicit fallback commands and include the routing curl + 1-line escalation notes.
Maya L: We'll schedule a short post-incident review tomorrow 10:00am to decide on permanent alert thresholds and SLA impact.
Alice C: Customer impact: SLO error budget not breached but a handful of customer requests saw timeouts (~0.1% of total). CS notified.
Carla R: marking as resolved in the incident channel, but keeping this thread for alert tuning follow-ups.
Bob (oncall): handing off to Carla for alert PR and follow-ups. I'm back on normal rotation.
Carla R: Ack — taking ownership. Will post updates on PR and dashboard when ready.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: previous_oncall=Bob (oncall) next_oncall=Carla R at 2369003899
Carla R: thanks all, closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
